scientific_integrity: Analytic steps give the theorem. The reproducibility code numerically tests examples and expressions but does not certify the infinite-order claims. The source paper publication date is the public arXiv v1 date, not a later revision.
scientific_limitations: Proof assumes a passive, uniformly elliptic Gaussian diffusive colloid in two dimensions, a stationary initial orientation on axes modulo pi, independent Poisson resets to absolute random axes, and no spatial resetting or self-propulsion. The claim is isotropy of finite spatial moments for every positive time, not isotropy of the full distribution. The static quadrature support argument is classical; broader additive-functional results may implicitly imply some dynamic comparisons. Numerical ODE checks are not interval certificates; independent scientific review has not been performed.
title: Sharp angular-reset alphabets for finite-time isotropy of an anisotropic Brownian colloid
